decisions.reason: The skin and hair supplement no longer appeared on the website in 2020–2021, which suggests lower priority, but it is cheap to keep in pharmacy distribution within the established supplement line.
The joint health supplement under the Trivital brand serves a large, ageing pharmacy customer base, so it is likely retained despite its reduced web presence.
The niche mushroom-based immune supplement has disappeared from the website and likely sells little, so its resources are better used in the core business and new development.
The OTC migraine triptan is a differentiated, approved consumer health product that fits the strategy of broadening the OTC portfolio, and the missing archive pages say nothing about its performance.
